name: store-inventory-display-projection
usernameSql: SELECT u.username FROM store_memberships m JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=m.user_id JOIN store_master s ON s.id=m.store_id WHERE m.status='ACTIVE' AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND (m.effective_from IS NULL OR m.effective_from<=NOW()) AND (m.effective_to IS NULL OR m.effective_to>=NOW()) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 1
pathSql: SELECT '/api/v2/store-sales/inventory?storeCode=' || s.store_code || '&limit=100' FROM store_memberships m JOIN store_master s ON s.id=m.store_id WHERE m.status='ACTIVE' AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND (m.effective_from IS NULL OR m.effective_from<=NOW()) AND (m.effective_to IS NULL OR m.effective_to>=NOW()) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 1
